meta.note: confirmed = two independent public sources; candidate = plausible, needs confirmation. Calibration computes over confirmed only.

entries.name: Livongo Health
events: Acquired by Teladoc Health in an ~$18.5B merger announced August 2020

evidence.text: Merger with Teladoc announced at ~$18.5B enterprise value, among the largest digital-health deals of its period (2020).
Large employer and payer client base for diabetes/chronic condition remote monitoring (2019-2020).
Strong revenue growth trajectory prior to merger; public filings showed accelerating bookings (2020).

entries.name: Pear Therapeutics
events: Filed Chapter 11 April 2023

evidence.text: Filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and wound down operations (2023).
Core product relied on payer reimbursement that did not materialize at scale despite FDA clearance (2021-2022).
Severe cash constraints, workforce reductions before filing (2022-2023).

entries.name: Babylon Health
events: US subsidiary filed Chapter 7 August 2023; remaining business sold to eMed

evidence.text: US operations filed Chapter 7; core business sold in distressed transaction (2023).
Post-SPAC public listing followed severe valuation collapse (2022).
Contract losses with integrated delivery networks in US markets (2022-2023).

entries.name: Olive AI
events: Shut down October 2023; assets sold to competitors

evidence.text: Company shut down, selling product lines to competitors (2023).
Extended layoffs and product-line divestitures preceded shutdown (2022-2023).
Rapid expansion into many product areas diluted focus; customer ROI questioned (2022).

entries.name: Forward Health
events: Shut down consumer clinics November 2024

evidence.text: Ceased consumer clinic operations and shut down its flagship app (2024).
High-burn clinic model with limited member base relative to capital raised (2023-2024).
Pivot attempts toward government contracts did not sustain the consumer business (2024).

entries.name: 23andMe
events: Filed Chapter 11 March 2025

evidence.text: Filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy (2025).
Entire board resigned citing disagreement with founder direction (2024).
Data breach litigation exposure and collapse of therapeutics pipeline partnerships (2023-2024).

entries.name: Hinge Health
events: IPO on NYSE May 2025

evidence.text: Completed IPO (2025).
Sustained employer-channel revenue growth and public pre-IPO disclosures of profitability (2024).
Category leadership in employer digital MSK benefits alongside expanding care-delivery team (2023-2024).

entries.name: Omada Health
events: IPO on Nasdaq June 2025

evidence.text: Completed IPO (2025).
CDC-listed diabetes-prevention program scale and employer/payer distribution growth (2022-2024).
Participation in GLP-1 companion-care category expansion (2024).

entries.name: Transcarent
events: Acquired Accolade in a ~$621M deal announced January 2025

evidence.text: Acquired public company Accolade at a substantial premium (~$621M) (2025).
Large self-insured employer client roster and surgery/episode-of-care product traction (2024).
Aggressive consolidation posture in employer navigation category (2023-2025).

entries.name: Cerebral
events: DOJ settlement over controlled-substance prescribing practices May 2023; earlier FTC privacy action

evidence.text: DOJ settlement over prescribing practices including allegations of automatic refill of controlled substances (2023).
FTC enforcement over data-sharing practices (2023).
Large workforce reductions and retreat from controlled-substance prescribing (2022-2023).

entries.name: Teladoc Health
events: Major goodwill impairments 2022-2024 following Livongo merger

evidence.text: Multi-billion-dollar goodwill impairments over consecutive years reflecting merger value destruction (2022-2024).
Chronic-care (Livongo-derived) unit revenue growth slowed after merger integration (2023).
Core virtual-visit business matured; growth shifted to low-margin international/enterprise contracts (2024).

entries.name: Oscar Health
events: First full-year GAAP profitability for FY2024

evidence.text: Reported first full-year GAAP net profit (FY2024).
Membership growth and improved medical loss ratio over consecutive years (2023-2024).
Technology-led operations ('Reconciled Model') cited as driver of underwriting gains (2024).

entries.name: Zocdoc
events: $150M growth round 2021; sustained marketplace growth claims through 2024-2025

evidence.text: Raised $150M growth round at enhanced valuation after prior plateau (2021).
Company-reported bookings growth and profitability milestones (2024-2025).
Expanded into new specialties and payer partnerships (2023-2024).

entries.name: Hims & Hers
events: Sustained rapid revenue growth post-listing through 2024-2025

evidence.text: Consistent high-growth revenue trajectory across post-listing years (2022-2024).
Personalization/subscriptions model drove subscriber growth and rising revenue per user (2024).
Expanded into weight-health category with strong early adoption (2024).

entries.name: Amwell
events: Severe post-SPAC decline: reverse split 2023, continued losses

evidence.text: Reverse stock split amid sharp decline from post-SPAC valuation (2023).
Continued operating losses and shrinking cash runway across consecutive years (2022-2024).
Loss of anchor telehealth contract volumes to incumbent EHR-channel competitors (2023-2024).

entries.name: Bright Health / NeueHealth
events: Massive losses, exited ACA markets 2023, restructured as NeueHealth

evidence.text: Exited multiple ACA state markets after severe underwriting losses (2023).
Restructured into NeueHealth with scaled-down insurance operations (2023).
Compliance/delisting pressures and leadership turnover (2023).

entries.name: Health Catalyst
events: Chronic losses and equity value decline through 2023-2024

evidence.text: Persistent GAAP losses across post-IPO years (2020-2024).
Equity value far below IPO reference through the window (2023-2024).
Continued RCM/technical-services divestitures amid strategy narrowing (2023).

entries.name: Sword Health
events: Large 2022 round at $3B; company-reported profitability milestones 2024

evidence.text: Raised at $3B valuation, doubling prior mark (2022).
Company-reported profitability and member-growth milestones (2024).
Expanded into pelvic-health and mental-health adjacent categories (2023-2024).

entries.name: Ro (Roman)
events: Company-reported profitability 2022-2023; no subsequent up event in window

evidence.text: Company-reported cash-flow positive periods during industry repricing (2022-2023).
Layoffs and category consolidation as pandemic-era demand normalized (2023).
No public up-round or liquidity event within the window (2022-2024).

entries.name: Noom
events: Layoffs 2022-2023, strategy pivots

evidence.text: Two rounds of layoffs within the window amid growth deceleration (2022-2023).
Pivot toward clinical/medication-assisted programs after consumer-course decline (2023-2024).
No public up-round after 2021 within the window (2022-2024).

entries.name: Calm
events: Profitable but no public up event in window

evidence.text: Company-reported profitability sustained across the window (2021-2024).
Consumer wellness category slowdown post-2021; enterprise pivot (2023).
No public liquidity event or round within the window (2022-2024).

entries.name: Headspace
events: Ginger merger 2021; layoffs 2023

evidence.text: Merged with Ginger to form combined entity at reduced effective valuation (2021).
Workforce reductions amid consumer slowdown (2023).
Enterprise pivot with mixed traction vs category peers (2023-2024).

entries.name: K Health
events: Layoffs 2022-2023; continued operations

evidence.text: Workforce reductions during industry repricing (2022-2023).
Payer/employer partnerships continued but scaled modestly (2023-2024).
No public up-round within the window (2022-2024).

entries.name: Lyra Health
events: Layoffs August 2023

evidence.text: Workforce reduction despite category-leading valuation (2023).
Employer buying slowdown in mental-health benefits category (2023-2024).
No public up-round after 2021 within the window (2022-2024).

entries.name: Spring Health
events: Large 2023-2024 raises; category expansion

evidence.text: Raised large growth rounds during industry repricing (2023-2024).
Continued employer logo growth and international expansion (2024).
Category consolidation with precision-mental-health positioning (2024).

entries.name: Headway
events: Large 2023-2024 raises ($125M Series C+); continued growth

evidence.text: Raised major growth rounds during sector repricing (2023-2024).
Therapist-network and payer-coverage expansion (2023-2024).
Positioned as claims-infrastructure layer rather than care provider (2024).

entries.name: Included Health
entries.seriesWindow: 2021 Grand Rounds × Doctor On Demand merger
events: Merger of Grand Rounds and Doctor On Demand 2021; continued consolidation

evidence.text: Merged two scaled entities into unified navigation + virtual-care platform (2021).
Expanded LGBTQ+ and dedicated-care employer offerings (2022-2024).
Continued enterprise client growth within window (2023-2024).

entries.name: SteadyMD
events: Series C 2022; refocus toward infrastructure partnerships

evidence.text: Raised Series C then narrowed focus to clinician-operations infrastructure (2022-2023).
Partner-dependent revenue model amid DTC telehealth slowdown (2023-2024).
No public up-round within window after Series C (2023-2024).

entries.name: Two Chairs
events: Series B 2022; measured expansion since

evidence.text: Raised Series B with measurement-based-care positioning (2022).
Deliberate clinical-quality-first expansion, slower growth than category peers (2023-2024).
No public up-round within window after Series B (2023-2024).

entries.name: Brightline
events: Layoffs 2022; wound down core clinical operations 2023-2024

evidence.text: Significant workforce reductions amid pediatric behavioral-health demand collapse post-2021 (2022).
Wound down direct clinical operations and shifted model (2023-2024).
Payer-contract strategy did not reach sustainable unit economics (2023).
